title: Control plane authentication
description: Multi-issuer OIDC JWT authentication and read/apply claim authorization rules for the Plat5 control plane admin API (AUTH_CONFIG_FILE).

issuers.title: issuers
issuers.description: Trusted OIDC/JWT issuers. Each entry must have a unique `name` and unique `issuer` URL.

name.title: name
name.description: Short unique label for this issuer (recorded in revision attribution and `GET /auth/info`), e.g. `github-actions` or `okta`.

issuer.title: issuer
issuer.description: Exact JWT `iss` claim value and base URL for OIDC Discovery (`{issuer}/.well-known/openid-configuration`).

jwks_uri.title: jwks_uri
jwks_uri.description: Optional explicit JWKS URI override. When omitted, discovered from `{issuer}/.well-known/openid-configuration`.

audiences.title: audiences
audiences.description: Allowed JWT `aud` claim values. Wildcard `*` is forbidden on the control plane.

subject_claim.title: subject_claim
subject_claim.description: Dotted JSON path to the stable caller subject claim. Default `sub`.

max_token_lifetime.title: max_token_lifetime
max_token_lifetime.description: Optional maximum allowed token lifetime (`exp - iat`, e.g. `1h` or `24h`). Requires numeric `iat` when set.

cli.title: cli
cli.description: Optional non-secret OAuth 2.0 public client metadata advertised on `GET /auth/info` for `plat5 login`.

rules.title: rules
rules.description: Authorization rules mapping required JWT claims to `read` or `apply` access. Evaluated as OR across rules, AND across claims within a rule.

client_id.title: client_id
client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 public client ID used by `plat5 login` (RFC 8252 PKCE and RFC 8628 Device Flow).

audience.title: audience
audience.description: Optional OAuth `audience` parameter sent during `plat5 login` (for IdPs such as Auth0 that require it).

scopes.title: scopes
scopes.description: OAuth scopes requested by `plat5 login`. Default `["openid"]`.

token_source.title: token_source
token_source.description: Which OAuth token `plat5 login` sends to the control plane (`access_token` default; use `id_token` for OIDC providers whose access tokens are opaque).

authorization_endpoint.title: authorization_endpoint
authorization_endpoint.description: Optional OAuth authorization endpoint override (otherwise discovered via OIDC Discovery).

token_endpoint.title: token_endpoint
token_endpoint.description: Optional OAuth token endpoint override (otherwise discovered via OIDC Discovery).

device_authorization_endpoint.title: device_authorization_endpoint
device_authorization_endpoint.description: Optional RFC 8628 device authorization endpoint override (otherwise discovered via OIDC Discovery).

access.title: access
access.description: `read` grants read endpoints and `POST /apply?dry_run=true`; `apply` grants all `read` endpoints plus mutating `POST /apply`.

claims.title: claims
claims.description: Required JWT claims (all keys must match; each key matches if any listed pattern matches). Patterns use full-string anchored `*` globbing; bare `*` is forbidden.
